thread:
Maria T.: Heads up — batch of runtime deps with CVEs landed in intake: protobuf (CVE-2026-1001) deserialization RCE, sentencepiece (CVE-2026-1002) mem-corrupt, vLLM advisory (CVE-2026-1003) panic/RCE patch available v0.7.3, FlashAttention kernel (CVE-2026-1004) potential info/leak + OOB on some CUDA combos, Triton notes non-RCE ABI change. Need triage: priority order, quick mitigations, and a rollout plan. Also: will rotating our KMS key break image signature verification for the hotfixes?

Ali S.: protobuf RCE is the blocker — treat as P0. If we can push a patched protobuf wheel into our base images and CDN within 48h, we should do it for hosted API. Until patched, apply sandboxing mitigations for any untrusted input paths. We need an RBAC gate: only security+oncall can approve patch deploys. Also enable audit logging for these deploys.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-2512 (vuln: protobuf+sentencepiece+vllm+flash) and pipeline INF-2513 (canary rollout).

Jonathan K.: vLLM fix looks straightforward (source patch + release v0.7.3). Recommend we build a patched wheel and run model-inference smoke on 2 representative models (LLAMA2-13B, Red-Instruct-7B) in staging. Quantized runtimes should be checked — some q4* kernels can hit edge cases with the vLLM change.

Lee P.: Triton update note: the vendor has an ABI tweak and recommends a base image rebuild. That will touch CUDA/toolkit versions for dedicated pools. We should schedule a maintenance window for Dedicated nodes — driver compatibility matrix first. Canary plan: dev-cluster (2 nodes) -> 5% prod traffic -> 25% -> full. Monitor p99 latency and OOM rate.

Sophia R.: FlashAttention kernel patch requires recompiling their fused kernels against our CUDA baseline. Might need driver bump on some instances. I'll need infra to reserve ~10 GPUs for a kernel rebuild + validation run. Hotpatching kernels across nodes will require draining and cordoning.

Ana M.: I'll implement the RBAC change: new role scope "patch.deploy" and restrict PROD deploy approvals to security+oncall for the next 10 days. Also enabling audit events for deploys and storing events in our audit-log index with 90-day retention.

Maria T.: Proposed priority/SLAs: protobuf (CVE-2026-1001) — 48h hotfix + canary; sentencepiece (CVE-2026-1002) — 72h patch; vLLM (CVE-2026-1003) — 7d release + canary; FlashAttention (CVE-2026-1004) + Triton ABI — 7–14d with driver compatibility validation. Canary cadence: 6h smoke -> 24h metrics -> promote. Owners: protobuf = Ali+Sophia, sentencepiece = Jonathan, vLLM = Jonathan+Sophia, Triton = Lee, FlashAttention = Sophia+infra.

Ali S.: Quick Q on KMS: if we rotate the KMS key that cosign uses, will verification of previously-signed images fail for older signatures? If so, hold rotation until we finish canaries.

Lee P.: Confirmed: cosign + KMS model supports key versions, but image verify will fail if the key/version is removed. On GCP KMS we can keep old key versions for a grace window; best practice: do not delete old versions until all images are re-signed or no longer used. I suggest we DO NOT rotate the deploy key until these hotfix images are cut. I'll document key retention policy.

Sophia R.: Deployment checklist (runtime team):
1) Build base image with patched protobuf/sentencepiece/vllm bits
2) Rebuild FlashAttention kernel artifacts where needed
3) Sign images with cosign + KMS key "redwood-deploy-v2"
4) Push to canary repo and run regression evals (diff check of model outputs)
5) Canary rollout: 5% traffic, collect 24h metrics + regression alerts
6) Promote if green, otherwise rollback and debug

Jonathan K.: Tests to run during canary: eval prompts from the regression suite (1000 prompts), token-level diffs, embedding drift checks, and model perf (latency p50/p95/p99). Hook Optimize alerts to block promote on quality regression.

Ana M.: I'll add a Slack approval workflow in #eng-oncall for the canary -> prod promotion and wire audit events into the SIEM. Also adding an alert for any unexpected RBAC grant usage during the window.

Maria T.: Assigned in INF-2512. Can everyone ack owners and timelines? If no objections I'll trigger the protobuf wheel build and image cut within the next 2h. :thumbsup:

Ali S.: Ack. prioritizing protobuf workqueue.

Jonathan K.: Ack, will start vLLM build and tests.

Lee P.: Ack — prepping driver matrix and reserving maintenance window.

Sophia R.: Ack — reserving GPUs for kernel rebuild.

Ana M.: Ack — RBAC + audit changes in progress.

ops-bot: INF-2512 updated: owners set, timeline pinned, canary pipeline INF-2513 scheduled.
